newsitem.title: USA: ITEX says court granted summary judgment.
newsitem.headline: ITEX says court granted summary judgment.

text.p: ITEX Corp on Wednesday said a U.S. federal judge granted a motion for partial summary judgment in a breach-of-contract case filed by SLI Inc, now a ITEX subsidiary.

The motion requested the court enter a judgment on the plaintiff's claim regarding performance and alleged breach of contract by defendants Saul Yarmak, Business Exchange International Corp and BX International Inc, the company said.
In January 1996, ITEX bought SLI Inc, which in turn bought a 50 percent interest in Business Exchange International, from owner Saul Yarmak, the company said.

At the time, ITEX said it believed it had become a 50-percent owner in a company that operated the BXI trade exchange. But Yarmak, who had the other 50 percent stake in Business Exchange, said that company did not own the BXI trade exchange and ITEX had not bought an interest in the exchange.
Yarmak said Business Exchange was the owner of trade exchange in the stock purchase agreement, according to ITEX.

The judge ruled from the bench in ITEX's favor. The order included a decree compelling the defendants to specifically perform under the contract and, if needed, cause the transfer of the trade exchange to Business Exchange International, the company said.
SLI's lawyers had to draft an order for signature by the court, ITEX said.
